audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on SIX of seven rows. Content read Akali 1-7; full read Anivia, Anivia, Skill, Skill, Anivia, Skill, Anivia. The page rendered two different answers at every level except 3 and 4-5.
audit.why: Grounded resolution: Anivia's Flash Frost reaches 1075 and Akali has no gap-closer until Shuriken Flip at level 3, so Anivia owns levels 1-2. From 3 onward Akali has Twilight Shroud plus an 825-range E, Anivia has no dash or blink anywhere in her kit, and the matchup sits at 52.11% over 1211 games for Akali. Chart proposed as Anivia, Anivia, Akali, Akali, Akali, Akali, Akali.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group so both layers land together.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Glacial Storm cannot punish the shroud engage because 'she can't see you inside it to land skillshots' — that misses the actual level 6 mechanic.
audit.why: Riot's E text: Frostbite damage doubles if the target was recently hit by Flash Frost OR damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm. That doubling chain, not vision, is what her 6 is.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten around breaking the Glacial-Storm-into-Frostbite doubling with the shroud's target denial.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] claimed Shroud dodges 'her Frostbite/Flash Frost combo entirely'. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable by spells — that stops Frostbite, which is cast 'at her target'. Flash Frost is a skillshot sphere and still lands in the smoke. The page also never mentioned that Crystallize is impassable terrain that stops Akali's E dash and R.
audit.why: Owner W text: 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Enemy W text: 'impassable wall of ice to block all movement', flagged terrain. Owner E and R are both dashes.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now separate the targeted spell from the skillshot and name the wall as a dash-stopper.

audit.why: Flash Frost is 11/10/9/8/7, Crystallize a flat 17s, Frostbite a flat 4s. The 17s wall window is the real all-in green light and the 4s Frostbite explains why every trade takes one.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry was a template that never mentioned Rebirth.
audit.why: Anivia's passive reverts her to an egg at full health on fatal damage — she is the one mid laner you have to kill twice, which changes how you spend Ignite and your second rotation.

edits.before: Your ability to dodge her skillshot poke and punish her lack of mobility gives you the early edge
edits.after: Flash Frost reaches 1075 and you have no way to close before level 3 without eating the stun

edits.before: Your Shroud engage voids her Flash Frost setup and she can't track you to punish the dive
edits.after: Anivia still holds you off at range — Shuriken Flip is not up until 3, so she farms you down

edits.before: Even with Glacial Storm zoning, Anivia has no way to punish your Shroud-stealth engage since she can't see you inside it to land skillshots.
edits.after: Glacial Storm doubles her Frostbite once it fully forms — break that chain by shrouding, which strips her E's target lock even while you stand in the storm.

edits.before: Use Shroud to go invisible and dodge her Frostbite/Flash Frost combo entirely
edits.after: Shroud denies Frostbite's targeting; Flash Frost still lands, so sidestep it

edits.before: - Anivia Flash Frost (Stun): matchup-defining — The slow-moving stun starts every Anivia kill — sidestep it and her E never doubles. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Twilight Shroud like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Flash Frost: 11s at rank 1 and the start of every kill — sidestep it and Frostbite never doubles. - Crystallize is a flat 17s wall of impassable terrain that hard-stops your E dash and your R; go around it or wait it out. - Frostbite is 4s, so expect one every trade.

edits.before: Track Anivia’s Flash Frost (Stun): The slow-moving stun starts every Anivia kill — sidestep it and her E never doubles. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Flash Frost (11s) is the stun that doubles Frostbite — sidestep it and her damage halves. Crystallize is a flat 17s wall that hard-stops your E dash and your R.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by killing Anivia twice: Rebirth leaves an egg at full health, so bank Ignite or a second rotation for it.

edits.before: If Anivia opens the score, reset expectations and respect Flash Frost (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Anivia opens the score, Glacial Storm zones you off the wave entirely — farm at Q range, sidestep Flash Frost, and take your fights only in the window her 17s wall is spent.
